svg.title: x402 payment lifecycle (V2, all three payment flows)
svg.desc: State diagram: x402 payment lifecycle (V2, all three payment flows). 11 states: Unpaid request, Payment required (402), Payload received, Verified, Committed before execution, Handler executed, Settlement pending, Settled, Rejected, Responded 200, and Voided or reclaimed. Starts in Unpaid request. Ends in Rejected, Responded 200, and Voided or reclaimed. 20 transitions. From Unpaid request to Payment required (402) when Server sends 402 (HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED). From Payment required (402) to Payload received when Client retries with a signed payload (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). From Payload received to Rejected when Malformed payload or requirements (HTTP 400). From Payload received to Verified when authorization flow: facilitator returns isValid true (POST /verify). From Payload received to Rejected when Facilitator returns isValid false, for example for an unsupported scheme or network (POST /verify, then HTTP 402). From Payload received to Rejected when Facilitator times out or returns malformed data (@x402/express answers 502 SDK behavior, not in the spec) (HTTP 502). From Payload received to Committed before execution when upfront or escrow flow: first settle succeeds (POST /settle). From Payload received to Rejected when upfront or escrow flow: first settle fails (POST /settle, then HTTP 402). From Verified to Handler executed when Handler runs. From Verified to Rejected when Handler fails: no settle, so the client is not charged. From Committed before execution to Handler executed when Handler runs. From Handler executed to Settled when authorization flow: settle succeeds, or escrow: capture succeeds (POST /settle). From Handler executed to Settlement pending when Settle broadcast but not confirmed, or timed out (POST /settle). From Settlement pending to Settled when SDK retries settle once and the facilitator reconciles against the broadcast hash. From Settlement pending to Rejected when Reconciliation shows no transfer and one retry fails (POST /settle). From Handler executed to Rejected when Settle fails (for example insufficient_funds) (HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-RESPONSE success false). From Handler executed to Voided or reclaimed when escrow: server voids the hold (POST /settle with payload.type void). From Handler executed to Voided or reclaimed when escrow: client reclaims an untouched hold after captureDeadline (reclaim called by the client on the escrow contract (never relayed through the facilitator)). From Settled to Responded 200 when Server returns the resource (HTTP 200 + PAYMENT-RESPONSE). From Handler executed to Responded 200 when upfront: payment already settled, server returns the resource (HTTP 200 + PAYMENT-RESPONSE).
